alt_title: Muhurat Trading, 2015-2025: Nine Rises, Two Falls, None Above 1%
description: Since 2015, the Nifty 50 closed higher on 9 of the 11 Diwali Muhurat sessions, against the previous day's close (our calculation from NSE's index data). The Sensex did the same. No session moved as much as 1% either way: the biggest rise was +0.88% in 2022, and the two falls were in 2016 (−0.14%) and 2017 (−0.63%). Last year's session rose 0.10%.
Muhurat 2026 is on Sunday 8 November; NSE says the timings will follow by circular. Past moves are not a forecast or advice.
